proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, (28) (second part, "by the obvious modifications of the arguments in the proof of the Constancy Theorem (2.34) and in 2.35"), in the form of step 4 of the parent proof, with the disjoint open neighbourhoods V_p of the open faces taken relative to the finitely many faces of s (here called W_p). Dependencies: FG = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_fr_face_geometry; DF = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_fr_divergence_form. For p ∈ s let A_p := Φ_p(Q₁) (nonempty: Φ_p(½, …, ½) ∈ A_p) and F_p the closed face; recall A_p ⊆ F_p (FG(5)).

1. Disjoint open neighbourhoods. For p ∈ s let W_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : infDist(x, A_p) < infDist(x, A_q) for every q ∈ s with q ≠ p} (W_p = ℝ^P if s = {p}). As x ↦ infDist(x, A) is continuous (1-Lipschitz), W_p is a finite intersection of open sets, hence open. The W_p are pairwise disjoint: x ∈ W_p ∩ W_q with p ≠ q would give infDist(x, A_p) < infDist(x, A_q) < infDist(x, A_p).

2. Σ_{p∈s} M_{W_p}(∂Q) ≤ M(∂Q). Write T := ∂Q ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) and, for every pair p, 𝒜_p := massAdmissibleOn univ m W_p (test m-forms ω with tsupport ω ⊆ W_p and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x); 0 ∈ 𝒜_p, and M_{W_p}(T) = sSup ((ω ↦ ofReal(T(ω))) '' 𝒜_p) = ⨆_{ω ∈ 𝒜_p} ofReal(T(ω)) (sSup_image'). (a) Family bound. Let (ω_p)_{p∈s} be any family with ω_p ∈ 𝒜_p. Put ω'_p := ω_p if T(ω_p) ≥ 0 and ω'_p := 0 otherwise; then ofReal(T(ω_p)) = ofReal(T(ω'_p)) and T(ω'_p) ≥ 0. Let ω := Σ_{p∈s} ω'_p, a test m-form. For each x at most one ω'_p(x) is nonzero (ω'_p(x) ≠ 0 gives x ∈ tsupport ω'_p ⊆ W_p, and the W_p, p ∈ s, are pairwise disjoint by step 1), so covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) is 0 or covectorEuclideanNorm(ω'_p(x)) ≤ 1; thus ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ m univ and, by linearity of T and ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg, Σ_{p∈s} ofReal(T(ω_p)) = ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} T(ω'_p)) = ofReal(T(ω)) ≤ T.massOn univ = M(T) (le_massOn). (b) Suprema. Index families by i : (p : pairs) → 𝒜_p (all pairs p, so that the index type does not depend on s) and put f_p(i) := ofReal(T(i p)); then ⨆_i f_p(i) = ⨆_{ω∈𝒜_p} ofReal(T(ω)) = M_{W_p}(T) (every ω ∈ 𝒜_p is i p for some family i, the 𝒜_q being nonempty). The family index is directed for all f_p simultaneously: for two families i, j choose at each p the member of {i p, j p} with the larger value of f_p. So ENNReal.finsetSum_iSup gives Σ_{p∈s} M_{W_p}(T) = Σ_{p∈s} ⨆_i f_p(i) = ⨆_i Σ_{p∈s} f_p(i) ≤ M(T) by (a). Hence Σ_{p∈s} M_{W_p}(∂Q) ≤ M(∂Q).

3. The numbers V_p. Since M(∂Q) ≠ ∞, step 2 gives M_{W_p}(∂Q) < ∞ for every p ∈ s. Put V_p := M_{W_p}(∂Q).toReal ≥ 0 for p ∈ s (and V_p := 0 otherwise). Then ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} V_p) = Σ_{p∈s} ofReal(V_p) = Σ_{p∈s} M_{W_p}(∂Q) ≤ M(∂Q).

4. A separation constant. Fix p ∈ s and g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ, C^∞, with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and |g| ≤ 1. G := Φ_p(tsupport g) is compact (Φ_p is continuous by FG(6)) and G ⊆ A_p. For q ∈ s with q ≠ p, FG(9) gives G ∩ F_q = ∅; F_q is closed (FG(8)) and nonempty, so w ↦ infDist(w, F_q) is continuous and positive on G (IsClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos) and, if G ≠ ∅, attains a positive minimum on G (IsCompact.exists_isMinOn). Choose δ > 0 with 3δ ≤ infDist(w, F_q) for every w ∈ G and every q ∈ s ∖ {p} (δ := 1 if G = ∅ or s = {p}).

5. The test form. DF applied to p, g and δ gives a test (n−1)-form ω with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x, such that every x ∈ tsupport ω satisfies dist(x, Φ_p(y)) ≤ δ for some y ∈ tsupport g, and dω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) = trace(Dg(y)) for every y ∈ ℝⁿ.

6. tsupport ω ⊆ W_p. Let x ∈ tsupport ω and y ∈ tsupport g with dist(x, Φ_p(y)) ≤ δ; w := Φ_p(y) ∈ G ⊆ A_p, so infDist(x, A_p) ≤ δ. For q ∈ s ∖ {p} and a ∈ A_q ⊆ F_q: dist(x, a) ≥ dist(w, a) − dist(x, w) ≥ 3δ − δ = 2δ, so infDist(x, A_q) ≥ 2δ > δ ≥ infDist(x, A_p). Hence x ∈ W_p. With step 5, ω is admissible for M_{W_p}(∂Q).

7. Evaluation. ∂Q(ω) = Q(dω), and the hypothesis applied to the test n-form dω gives ∂Q(ω) = Σ_{q∈s} ∫_{Q₁} u_q(y) dω(Φ_q(y))(e_q) dy. Let q ∈ s, q ≠ p, and y ∈ Q₁; then Φ_q(y) ∈ A_q, and Φ_q(y) ∉ tsupport ω, for otherwise Φ_q(y) ∈ W_p (step 6) would give infDist(Φ_q(y), A_p) < infDist(Φ_q(y), A_q) = 0, impossible. Since tsupport dω ⊆ tsupport ω (tsupport_exteriorDerivative_subset), dω(Φ_q(y)) = 0; so the q-th integrand vanishes on Q₁ and its integral is 0 (setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero). For q = p the integrand equals u_p(y)·trace(Dg(y)) for every y (step 5). Hence ∂Q(ω) = ∫_{Q₁} u_p(y) trace(Dg(y)) dy.

8. Conclusion. By step 6 and le_massOn, ofReal(∫_{Q₁} u_p trace(Dg)) = ofReal(∂Q(ω)) ≤ M_{W_p}(∂Q) < ∞. If the integral is ≤ 0 it is ≤ V_p since V_p ≥ 0; otherwise ∫_{Q₁} u_p trace(Dg) = (ofReal(∫ …)).toReal ≤ M_{W_p}(∂Q).toReal = V_p (ENNReal.toReal_mono). Together with step 3 this proves the statement. ∎
key_steps: W_p := {x : infDist(x, A_p) < infDist(x, A_q) for all q ∈ s, q ≠ p} are open and pairwise disjoint.
Disjointly supported admissible forms add to an admissible form, so Σ_p M_{W_p}(∂Q) ≤ M(∂Q) < ∞; set V_p := M_{W_p}(∂Q).toReal.
For admissible g, take δ from the positive distance of the compact Φ_p(spt g) to the other closed faces, and the divergence form ω of divergence_form; then tsupport ω ⊆ W_p.
∂Q(ω) = Q(dω) = ∫_{Q₁} u_p div g, because dω vanishes on the other open faces and dω(Φ_p y)(e_p) = div g(y).
Hence ∫_{Q₁} u_p div g ≤ M_{W_p}(∂Q).toReal = V_p.
